relatedSnapshot.title: Request for temporary discount for Name 1's Workspace
relatedSnapshot.description:
#### User Email

<email>

#### Workspace Name

Name 1's Workspace

#### Request Type

Discount code

#### Reason for request

Name 1 is experiencing temporary financial hardship due to significant personal circumstances, including unexpected tax obligations following the sale of his home, while rebuilding his business as a single father. During our Name 2 strategy call, he shared that cash flow has become his primary constraint and he is considering returning to full-time employment if he cannot generate revenue soon.

To help retain the client and maintain momentum, I'm requesting a temporary Name 3 credit/discount of **1 to 3 months**, with 5,000 lead credits, if approved. Name 1 remains highly engaged, has completed over 30 discovery meetings, and is actively implementing a revised outbound strategy with our team. We are rebuilding his campaign around a more effective interview-based approach and will be providing additional sales coaching to improve conversions.

Providing temporary platform relief will give him the runway needed to execute the new strategy without the immediate financial pressure of his subscription, improving retention and increasing the likelihood of generating client wins. This request is intended as a short-term retention measure while the new campaign is launched and begins producing opportunities.

relatedSnapshot.title: Apply credits for client: 12 inboxes, domains, 2 months Acquisity
relatedSnapshot.description:
#### Workspace Name

Name 19's Workspace (email is <email>)

#### Request Type

Discount code

#### Reason for request

THIS IS A HIGHLY ESCALATED SITUATION

This client was misinformed multiple times by our team that he could delete his Company One and ReachOutly accounts and still transfer the warmed custom domains and inboxes over to our platform. Obviously, that’s incorrect since we currently can’t import external email accounts into our workspace. We can only either provide pre-warmed accounts or set up and warm up done-for-you accounts.

He’s very frustrated because he said he had a gut feeling the info was wrong, but still chose to trust us as the experts. Now he feels burned because he lost time with no real progress, and also wasted money buying domains, accounts, and subscriptions on Company One and ReachOutly that he can’t use with us.

He vented quite a lot on a call with me just now, and also earlier during office hours. This has definitely escalated. He’s clearly upset and is blaming us for the wasted time and money.

To calm things down and avoid further escalation, I walked him through how we’ll set things up properly moving forward, and I offered some credits to make up for the situation. I told him we would cover inboxes and domains, plus give him some extra time on the platform since he now has to go through the warm-up process again.

What I agreed on the call:

1. 12 DFY inboxes covered for 3 months
2. Custom domains covered for 1 year
3. 1 month of Acquisity for free


If possible, I’d like to extend the Acquisity credits to 2 months instead of 1, just to go a bit above what was promised and help smooth things over further. If that’s not possible, no worries, but at least the 1 month should definitely be added.

Let me know if we can get these credits applied asap.
